agent_data_note: Use the official Gleipner paper artifact at `dataset_candidate/gleipner/`. Category JARs live under `algorithms/_target/`. Do not invent toy Java deserialization chains as a substitute for Gleipner.
benchmark_rules: Evaluate detectors against the provided Gleipner category JARs under `algorithms/_target/` (including basic, depth, polymorphism, multipath, reflection, ysoserial replicas).
Configure tools to search for sink `gleipner.core.SinkGadget.sinkMethod(String)`. Ground-truth TP/FP counts are in each JAR META-INF/MANIFEST.MF (`chains-tp`, `chains-fp`).
The shared Gleipner mount is read-only. Write tool outputs, logs, and metrics under `project/` or `results/`.
Use `java -jar $GLEIPNER_HOME/algorithms/evaluator.jar <output_file>` (or copy evaluator into a writable dir) to score tool outputs when possible.
Baseline detectors (Serianalyzer, GadgetInspector, Tabby, JDD, etc.) are optional — install or implement comparison methods as needed. Prefer JDK 8 for older tools via `$JAVA8_HOME`.
Do not claim full paper reproduction of all seven tools unless the experiment protocol and resources match.
non_goals: Pre-installing all seven paper baseline detectors as a benchmark requirement
Reconstructing Gleipner from scratch when the artifact JARs are already provided
Using fabricated Java gadget chains instead of the mounted Gleipner JARs
